item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 20/Nov/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A fresh to strong northeast monsoon will affect the coast of Guangdong in the next couple of days. Besides, upper-air disturbances will bring rainy weather to southern China midweek this week. With the departure of upper-air disturbances, showers will ease off gradually over the region in the latter part of this week.

Date/Month: 21/11 (Monday)
Wind: East force 4 to 5, occasionally force 6 offshore.
Weather: Mainly cloudy. One or two rain patches in the morning and at night. Sunny intervals during the day.
Temp range: 23 - 26 C
R.H. range: 70 - 90 per Cent
PSR: Low
